CREATE VIEW [STAR].[DIM_Products] AS
SELECT
	T1.[SATZ_ID],
	T1.[DAT_VON_HIST],
	T1.[DAT_BIS_HIST],
	T1.[ProductName],
	T1.[SupplierID],
	T1.[CategoryID],
	T1.[QuantityPerUnit],
	T1.[UnitPrice],
	T1.[UnitsInStock],
	T1.[UnitsOnOrder],
	T1.[ReorderLevel],
	T1.[Discontinued],
	T1.[ProductID]
FROM
	[DWH].[DIM_Products] T1
